Acceltra.t: Acceltra's main blueprint can be obtained from defeating Demolisher Infested on the Dark Sector mission Ur, Uranus.

Acrid.t: The Acrid's blueprint can be researched from the Bio Lab in the dojo.

Aegrit.t: Aegrit's blueprint is available from Chipper of Kahl's Garrison for 30 Stock, requiring players to be at Rank 4 - Settlement to purchase.

Aeolak.t: Aeolak's main blueprint can be acquired from Tier 5 Chrysalith Bounties. The barrel blueprint drops from Void Cascade. The receiver and stock blueprints drop from Void Flood. All components can be traded, but not the main blueprint.

Afentis.t: Afentis's blueprint is available from Chipper of Kahl's Garrison for 60 Stock, requiring players to be at Rank 5 - Home to purchase.

Afuris.t: The Afuris's blueprint can be purchased from the Market.

Akarius.t: Akarius's main blueprint can be obtained from defeating Demolisher Infested on the Dark Sector mission Ur, Uranus.

Akbolto.t: The Akbolto's blueprint can be purchased from the Market.

Akbronco.t: The Akbronco's blueprint can be purchased from the Market.

Akjagara.t: The Akjagara's blueprint can be purchased from the Market.

Aklato.t: A built Aklato can be purchased from the Market for 25,000 Credits.

Aklex.t: The Aklex's blueprint can be purchased from the Market.

Akmagnus.t: The Akmagnus's blueprint can be purchased from the Market.

Aksomati.t: The Aksomati's blueprint can be purchased from the Market.

Aksondol.t: Aksondol's blueprints can be purchased from Cephalon Melica on Yuvan Peak, Earth, or the Chrysalith, Zariman Ten Zero, for Entropic Kuva, which are dropped by Entropic Eximus in the Zariman.

Akstiletto.t: The Akstiletto's blueprint can be researched from the Tenno Lab in the dojo.

Akvasto.t: The Akvasto's blueprint can be purchased from the Market.

Akzani.t: The Akzani's blueprint can be purchased from the Market.

Alternox.t: Alternox's blueprint can be acquired from Tier 3 Chrysalith Bounties.

Ambassador.t: This weapon's main blueprint can be acquired from Rotation C of Empyrean Survival missions in Venus Proxima, Neptune Proxima, Pluto Proxima, and Veil Proxima. The component blueprints are dropped by Aurax Atloc Raknoids and Narmer Raknoids.

Amprex.t: The Amprex's blueprint can be researched from the Energy Lab in the dojo.

Angstrum.t: The Angstrum's blueprint can be purchased from the Market.

Arca Plasmor.t: The Arca Plasmor's blueprint can be researched from the Energy Lab in the dojo.

Arca Scisco.t: The Arca Scisco's blueprint can be researched from the Energy Lab in the dojo.

Argonak.t: The Argonak's blueprint can be researched from the Chem Lab in the dojo.

Ash.t: Ash's main blueprint can be purchased from the Market. Ash's component blueprints are obtained from Venus Proxima (Systems), Neptune Proxima (Neuroptics), and Pluto Proxima (Chassis) Survival, Defense, Exterminate, and Volatile missions.

Astilla.t: The Astilla's blueprint can be purchased from the Market.

Athodai.t: m. m. ET, on August 1st, 2020. It comes with a free weapon slot and pre-installed Orokin Catalyst.

Atlas.t: Atlas's main blueprint is awarded after completing The Jordas Precept Quest. Atlas's component blueprints can be obtained from defeating the Jordas Golem on Jordas Golem Assassinate, Eris, which is unlocked following the aforementioned quest.

Attica.t: The Attica's blueprint can be researched from the Tenno Lab in the dojo.

Banshee.t: Banshee's blueprints can be researched from the Tenno Lab in the Dojo. 0 missions.

Baruuk.t: Baruuk's blueprints can be purchased from Little Duck of Vox Solaris. The main blueprint requires players to be at Rank 2 - Agent, while component blueprints require Rank 3 - Hand.

Basmu.t: Basmu's blueprint is obtainable from limited-time events: Basmu was first introduced in Operation: Scarlet Spear, purchasable from Little Duck for 15,000 Scarlet Credits. Operation: Orphix Venom sold Basmu's blueprint from Father for 1,500 Phasic Cells.

Battacor.t: The Battacor's blueprint can be researched from the Energy Lab in the dojo.

Baza.t: The Baza's blueprint can be researched from the Tenno Lab in the dojo.

Boar.t: The Boar's blueprint is dropped by Drekar Troopers.

Boltor.t: The Boltor's blueprint can be purchased from the Market. Alternatively, a built Boltor is awarded from completing the Venus to Mercury Junction, complete with a free weapon slot and pre-installed Orokin Catalyst.

Bonewidow.t: Component blueprints for the Bonewidow are available for 3,500 Standing 3,500 from the Necraloid Syndicate at Rank 2 - Clearance: Modus, while the main Bonewidow blueprint is available for 10,000 Standing 10,000 at Rank 3 Clearance - Odima rank.

Braton.t: A fully built Braton can be purchased from the Market for 25,000 Credits. It can be sold for 7,500 Credits.

Bubonico.t: The Bubonico's blueprint can be researched from the Bio Lab in the dojo.

Burston.t: The Burston's blueprint and the resources required for its construction are awarded upon completion of Vor's Prize quest. Additional blueprints can be purchased from the Market.

Buzlok.t: The Buzlok's blueprint can be researched from the Chem Lab in the dojo.

Caliban.t: Caliban's main blueprint is purchased from the Market. His component blueprints are acquired from Narmer Bounties after completion of The New War.

Carmine Penta.t: This weapon's blueprints and components can be obtained from Pluto Proxima or Veil Proxima Corpus-controlled Abandoned Derelict Caches in Empyrean missions. All parts can be traded between players.

Cedo.t: Cedo's blueprint and components are available from Father with Entrati standing. The main blueprint requires players to be at Rank 4 - Friend, while components require Rank 5 - Family.

Cernos.t: The Cernos's blueprint can be purchased from the Market.

Chroma.t: Chroma's main blueprint is rewarded upon completion of the quest The New Strange.

Cinta.t: Cinta's main and component blueprints are acquired by solving Enigma puzzles in Duviri, having a 30% chance to drop one part from any puzzle completion. All blueprints are tradable.

Citrine.t: Citrine's main and component blueprints can be obtained from Rotation C of Mirror Defense Tyana Pass on Mars, whose access requires completion of Heart of Deimos.

Convectrix.t: The Convectrix's blueprint can be researched from the Energy Lab in the dojo.

Corinth.t: The Corinth's blueprint can be purchased from the Market.

Cyte-09.t: Cyte-09's main blueprint is acquired upon completion of The Hex quest. His component blueprints are acquired from Höllvania Central Mall Bounties as an uncommon drop.

Dagath.t: Dagath's main and component blueprints are acquired from Dagath's Hollow within the Clan Dojo. Unlike most Clan Dojo rooms, Dagath does not require Research and can be acquired immediately following the room's construction.

Daikyu.t: The Daikyu's blueprint can be researched from the Tenno Lab in the dojo.

Dante.t: Dante's main and component blueprints can be obtained from Rotation C of Disruption Armatus on Deimos. Access requires completion of The Deadlock Protocol and Whispers in the Walls.

Dera.t: The Dera's blueprint can be researched from the Energy Lab in the dojo.

Dera Vandal.t: Blueprints and components are a potential Invasion reward. All components can be traded, although players must have a Mastery Rank of at least 7 to acquire the blueprint.

Dex Sybaris.t: The Dex Sybaris was released in commemoration of WARFRAME's 3rd Year Anniversary. It is obtainable through yearly anniversaries in March via Alerts, complete with a free weapon slot and a pre-installed Orokin Catalyst.

Drakgoon.t: The Drakgoon's blueprint can be purchased from the Market. Alternatively, it can be acquired from completing the Neptune to Pluto Junction.

Dread.t: Dread's blueprint is dropped by the Stalker. It is also included in the What Stalker? bundle for 725 Platinum in the market.

Ember.t: Ember's main blueprint can be purchased from the Market. Ember's component blueprints are acquired from General Sargas Ruk (Tethys, Saturn).

Enkaus.t: Enkaus's main and component blueprints can be obtained from Follie's Hunt. Access requires completion of the Chains of Harrow Quest.

Equinox.t: Equinox requires a unique method to craft: Tenno must forge both the Equinox Night Aspect and Equinox Day Aspect in the Foundry – each of which requires its respective Neuroptics, Chassis, and Systems – before the Warframe itself can be built.

Evensong.t: Evensong's blueprint is obtained from Ascension on Brutus, Uranus, at a 5% drop rate.

Excalibur.t: Excalibur is one of the three starter Warframes, alongside Mag and Volt, during Awakening. Excalibur's main blueprint can be purchased from the Market. Excalibur's component blueprints can be obtained from defeating Lieutenant Lech Kril on War, Mars.

Excalibur Umbra.t: The blueprint for Excalibur Umbra is given to players upon completing the first mission of The Sacrifice quest, and the ability to build the Warframe is granted on completing the second mission.

Exergis.t: The Exergis's blueprint can be purchased from the Market.

Felarx.t: Felarx's main blueprint is purchased from Cavalero of The Holdfasts at Rank 3 - Guardian for 8,000 Standing 8,000 Standing. The blueprint can be traded.

Ferrox.t: The Ferrox's blueprint can be researched from the Energy Lab in the dojo.

Flux Rifle.t: The Flux Rifle's blueprint can be researched from the Energy Lab in the dojo.

Follie.t: Follie's main and component blueprints can be obtained from Rotation A of Follie's Hunt on Vesper Relay, Venus. Access requires completion of Chains of Harrow.

Frost.t: Frost's main blueprint can be purchased from the Market. Frost's component blueprints can be obtained from defeating Captain Vor & Lieutenant Lech Kril on Exta, Ceres.

Fulmin.t: The Fulmin's blueprint can be purchased from the Market.

Gara.t: Gara's main blueprint is awarded upon completion of the Saya's Vigil quest. Gara's component blueprints are acquired from Plains of Eidolon Bounties. Additional main blueprints can be bought from Cephalon Simaris for 50,000 Standing 50,000.

Garuda.t: Garuda's main blueprint is awarded upon completion of the Vox Solaris quest. Garuda's component blueprints are acquired from Orb Vallis Bounties. Additional main blueprints can be bought from Cephalon Simaris for 50,000 Standing 50,000.

Gauss.t: Gauss's main blueprint can be purchased from the Market. Gauss's component blueprints drop from Tier C Disruption on Kappa, Sedna. 84% drop chance.

Glaxion.t: The Glaxion's blueprint can be researched from the Energy Lab in the dojo.

Glaxion Vandal.t: The weapon is periodically sold by Baro Ki'Teer in the Concourse section of the Tenno Relay for 250,000 Credits and 475. Note that Baro Ki'Teer's stock changes with each appearance, and this weapon may not be available on a succeeding appearance.

Gorgon.t: The Gorgon's blueprint can be dropped by Heavy Gunners, Arid Heavy Gunners, Grineer Wardens, and Gokstad Officers.

Gorgon Wraith.t: The blueprint and parts drop from the Razorback Assassination Alert. All parts can be traded, although players must have attained Mastery Rank 7 to acquire the blueprint.

Grakata.t: The Grakata's blueprint can be purchased from the Market.

Grendel.t: Grendel's main blueprint can be purchased from the Market.

Grinlok.t: The Grinlok's blueprint can be researched from the Chem Lab in the dojo.

Gyre.t: Gyre's component and main blueprints can be acquired from The Holdfasts bounties on the Chrysalith.

Haalvu.t: Haalvu can be purchased during Epoch Operation: Taubound from Praghasa for 150 Moonflesh. m. m. ET (UTC -4), on July 11th, 2026. It comes with a free Weapon Slot and pre-installed Orokin Catalyst.

Harpak.t: The Harpak's blueprint can be purchased from the Market.

Harrow.t: Harrow's main blueprint is awarded upon completion of the Chains of Harrow quest.

Hek.t: The Hek's blueprint can be purchased from the Market.

Hema.t: The Hema's blueprint can be researched from the Bio Lab in the dojo.

Higasa.t: Higasa's blueprint and components can be obtained from Shrine Defense on Saya's Visions, Earth. Access requires completion of Saya's Vigil and Once Awake.

Hildryn.t: Hildryn's main blueprint can be purchased from Little Duck for 5,000 Standing 5,000 upon reaching Rank 2 - Agent with Vox Solaris. Hildryn's component blueprints can be acquired from Exploiter Orb.

Hind.t: The Hind's blueprint can be purchased from the Market.

Hydroid.t: Hydroid's main blueprint can be purchased from the Market. Hydroid's component blueprints can be obtained from defeating from Councilor Vay Hek on Oro, Earth. The mission requires Mastery Rank 5 to enter.

Ignis.t: The Ignis's blueprint can be researched from the Chem Lab in the dojo.

Ignis Wraith.t: The blueprint drops from Abandoned Derelict Caches in Grineer-controlled Veil Proxima missions.

Inaros.t: Inaros's main and component blueprints are obtained from the Sands of Inaros quest. The quest blueprint is tradeable from another player, or purchasable from Baro Ki'Teer for 100 + 25,000 Credits.

Ivara.t: Ivara's main blueprint can be purchased from the Market. Ivara's component blueprints are acquired from Spy missions (including Nightmare Mode) depending on mission level. Alerts and Sorties do not award identified items and therefore are exempt.

Jade.t: Jade's main blueprint is acquired upon completion of the Jade Shadows quest. Her component blueprints are obtained from Ascension on Brutus, Uranus, at a 5% drop rate.

Javlok.t: The Javlok's blueprint can be researched from the Chem Lab in the dojo.

Karak.t: The Karak's blueprint can be purchased from the Market.

Karak Wraith.t: Karak Wraith was introduced during the Operation: Tubemen of Regor event, where players would need to complete a minimum of four regional battles in favor of one side more than the other, and Alad V was the victor of the conflict.

Khora.t: Khora's main blueprint can be purchased from the Market. Khora's component blueprints are acquired from standard Sanctuary Onslaught (not the Elite variant). Every two stages is a rotation, following the standard A-A-B-C pattern.

Kohm.t: The Kohm's blueprint can be purchased from the Market.

Komorex.t: The Komorex's blueprint can be researched from the Energy Lab in the dojo.

Koumei.t: Koumei's main and component blueprints can be obtained from Shrine Defense on Saya's Visions, Earth. Access requires completion of Saya's Vigil and Once Awake.

Kullervo.t: Kullervo's main and component blueprints are purchased from Acrithis in the Dormizone for Kullervo's Bane; the main blueprint requires 15 Banes, while the parts require 9, to a total of 42 Kullervo's Banes.

Lanka.t: The Lanka's blueprint can be researched from the Energy Lab in the dojo.

Latron.t: The Latron's blueprint can be purchased from the Market.

Latron Wraith.t: This weapon was awarded during the Operation: Cryotic Front event to players who extracted 3000 Cryotic in a single mission, complete with a free weapon slot and a pre-installed Orokin Catalyst.

Lavos.t: Lavos's main and component blueprints are available from Father with Entrati standing. The main blueprint requires players to be at Rank 2 - Acquaintance, while component blueprints require Rank 3 - Associate.

Lenz.t: The Lenz's blueprint can be researched from the Energy Lab in the dojo.

Limbo.t: Limbo's main blueprint can be purchased from the Market. Component blueprints are awarded from The Limbo Theorem quest, obtainable by completing the Europa Junction on Jupiter.

Loki.t: Loki's main blueprint can be purchased from the Market. Loki's component blueprints can be obtained from defeating the Hyena Pack on Psamathe, Neptune.

Mag.t: Mag is one of the three starter Warframes, alongside Excalibur and Volt, during Awakening. Mag's main blueprint can be purchased from the Market. Mag's component blueprints can be obtained from defeating The Sergeant on Iliad, Phobos.

Mesa.t: Mesa's main blueprint can be purchased from the Market.

Mirage.t: Mirage's main blueprint can be purchased from the Market. Component blueprints are awarded at the end of each mission for the Hidden Messages quest. Additional blueprints can be bought from Cephalon Simaris for 25,000 Standing 25,000.

Miter.t: Miter's main blueprint and components can be obtained from the dual boss team Lech Kril and Captain Vor on Exta, Ceres.

Mk1-Braton.t: Mk1-Braton be purchased from the Market for 15,000 Credits. It can be sold for 2,500 Credits.

Mk1-Paris.t: Mk1-Paris can be purchased from the Market for 15,000 Credits.

Mk1-Strun.t: A built Mk1-Strun can be purchased from the Market for 15,000 Credits.

Mutalist Cernos.t: The Mutalist Cernos's blueprint can be purchased from the Market.

Mutalist Quanta.t: The Mutalist Quanta's blueprint can be researched from the Bio Lab in the dojo.

Nagantaka.t: The Nagantaka's blueprint can be purchased from the Market.

Narin.t: Narin's main and component blueprints can be obtained as mission rewards aboard the Zariman Ten Zero.

Nataruk.t: Nataruk is given upon completion of The New War, complete with a free weapon slot and a pre-installed Orokin Catalyst. Additional copies of Nataruk can be bought from Cephalon Simaris for 100,000 Standing 100,000.

Nekros.t: Nekros' main blueprint can be purchased from the Market. Nekros' component blueprints can be obtained from defeating Lephantis on Magnacidium, Deimos.

Nezha.t: Nezha's blueprints can be researched from the Tenno Lab in the dojo.

Nidus.t: Nidus' main blueprint is acquired from The Glast Gambit quest; additional main blueprints can be bought from Cephalon Simaris for 50,000 Standing 50,000.

Nokko.t: Nokko's main and component blueprints are acquired from Deepmines Bounties as an uncommon and rare drop. Access requires completion of The New War.

Nova.t: Nova's main blueprint can be purchased from the Market. Nova's component blueprints can be obtained from defeating the Raptors on Naamah, Europa.

Nunchasa.t: Nunchasa's blueprints can be purchased from Cephalon Melica on Yuvan Peak, Earth, or the Chrysalith, Zariman Ten Zero, for Entropic Kuva, which are dropped by Entropic Eximus in the Zariman.

Nyx.t: Nyx's main blueprint can be purchased from the Market. Nyx's component blueprints can be obtained from defeating Phorid on assassination missions that appear during an Infested Invasion.

Oberon.t: Oberon's main blueprint can be purchased from the Market. Oberon's component blueprints are obtained from Earth Proxima (Neuroptics & Systems) and Saturn Proxima (Chassis) Points of Interest in Empyrean missions.

Octavia.t: Octavia's main blueprint and the Mandachord are acquired from the Octavia's Anthem quest. The Chassis blueprint is rewarded from the Music Puzzle on Lua. The Neuroptics blueprint is rewarded from Rotation C of Terrorem (Survival), Deimos.

Ogris.t: The Ogris's blueprint can be researched from the Chem Lab in the dojo.

Opticor.t: The Opticor's blueprint can be researched from the Energy Lab in the dojo.

Opticor Vandal.t: This weapon is awarded for earning 100 points from the recurring Thermia Fractures event that was first introduced in Operation: Buried Debts, complete with a free weapon slot and a pre-installed Orokin Catalyst.

Oraxia.t: Oraxia's main and component blueprints can be obtained from Isleweaver in Duviri. Access requires completion of The Hex Quest.

Orion & Sirius.t: Sirius & Orion's main blueprint is acquired upon completion of the Jade Shadows: Constellations quest. Their component blueprints are obtained from Scoria's Angel or The Kuva Wytch on Uranus Proxima via Empyrean Railjack.

Panthera.t: The Panthera's blueprint can be purchased from the Market.

Paracyst.t: The Paracyst's blueprint can be researched from the Bio Lab in the dojo.

Paris.t: The Paris's blueprint can be purchased from the Market.

Penta.t: The Penta's blueprint can be purchased from the Market. Alternatively, it can be acquired from completing the Jupiter to Saturn Junction.

Perigale.t: Perigale's blueprint and components can be obtained from Conjunction Survival Yuvarium and Circulus on Lua, whose access requires completion of The War Within; the blueprint comes from Rotation A, while the Barrel, Receiver, and Stock come from Rotation B.

Phage.t: The Phage's blueprint can be researched from the Bio Lab in the dojo.

Phantasma.t: The Phantasma's blueprint can be purchased from the Market.

Phenmor.t: Phenmor's main blueprint is purchased from Cavalero of The Holdfasts at Rank 2 - Watcher for 6,000 Standing 6,000 Standing. The blueprint can be traded.

Prisma Gorgon.t: The Prisma Gorgon is potentially sold by Baro Ki'Teer in the Concourse section of the Tenno Relay for 50,000 Credits and 600. Note that Baro Ki'Teer's stock changes with each appearance, and this weapon may not be available on a succeeding appearance.

Prisma Grakata.t: The Prisma Grakata is potentially sold by Baro Ki'Teer in the Concourse section of the Tenno Relay for 100,000 Credits and 610. Note that Baro Ki'Teer's stock changes with each appearance, and this weapon may not be available on a succeeding appearance.

Prisma Grinlok.t: The Prisma Grinlok is potentially sold by Baro Ki'Teer in the Concourse section of the Tenno Relay for 220,000 Credits and ‍ 500. Note that Baro Ki'Teer's stock changes with each appearance, and this weapon may not be available on a succeeding appearance.

Prisma Lenz.t: The Prisma Lenz is potentially sold by Baro Ki'Teer in the Concourse section of the Tenno Relay for 200,000 Credits and 575. Note that Baro Ki'Teer's stock changes with each appearance, and this weapon may not be available on a succeeding appearance.

Prisma Tetra.t: The Prisma Tetra is potentially sold by Baro Ki'Teer in the Concourse section of the Tenno Relay for 50,000 Credits and 400. Note that Baro Ki'Teer's stock changes with each appearance, and this weapon may not be available on a succeeding appearance.

Proboscis Cernos.t: The Proboscis Cernos's blueprint can be purchased from the Market.

Protea.t: Protea's main blueprint is rewarded upon completion of The Deadlock Protocol quest (requires Saturn Junction and Mastery Rank 4). Additional main blueprints can be bought from Cephalon Simaris for 50,000 Standing 50,000.

Purgator 1.t: Purgator 1's blueprints can be purchased from Minerva of The Hex for Standing Standing Standing; component blueprints for 5,000 Standing 5,000 and the main blueprint for 15,000 Standing 15,000 to a total of 30,000 Standing 30,000, all requiring Rank 5 - Pizza Party.

Qorvex.t: Qorvex's main blueprint is acquired upon completion of Whispers in the Walls quest. His component blueprints are acquired from Sanctum Anatomica Bounties as an uncommon drop.

Quanta.t: The Quanta's blueprint can be researched from the Energy Lab in the dojo.

Quanta Vandal.t: This weapon was originally obtained by gaining at least 1,500 points in the Operation False Profit event, complete with a free weapon slot and a pre-installed Orokin Catalyst.

Quartakk.t: The Quartakk's blueprint can be acquired as a reward from performing special Ghoul Purge Bounties, or dropped by Ghoul Auger Alphas. The built weapon can also be bought from the Market individually, or as part of the Maggor Assault Pack.

Quellor.t: The Quellor's main blueprint can be obtained from defeating Blite Captain, Glacik Commander, Lektro Commander, or Pyr Captain in Empyrean missions (at Kasio's Rest on Saturn Proxima, Flexa in Veil Proxima, or sometimes Korms Belt in Earth Proxima).

Rakta Cernos.t: The Rakta Cernos can be acquired by reaching the Rank of Exalted with the Red Veil, and spending 125,000 Standing 125,000 to purchase. As with all Syndicate Weapons, the Rakta Cernos cannot be chosen as the free offering upon ranking up to Exalted rank.

Rauta.t: In the first two weeks after The Seven Crimes of Kullervo launched (June 21st, 2023 @ 12 PM ET until July 5th, 2023 @ 12 PM ET), entering Duviri via the Star Chart banner and Dormizone door would present all players with an event mission called Kullervo's Hold, which was based on The Lone Story's spiral-focused gameplay and always included the dungeon island in the Duviri Landscape regardless of the current Mood Spiral.

Reconifex.t: Reconifex's main blueprint is awarded from Tier 5 Höllvania Central Mall Bounties as a rare drop, requiring the completion of The Hex to access. The Barrel, Receiver, and Stock are awarded from Höllvania Legacyte Harvest and Hell-Scrub.

Revenant.t: Revenant's main blueprint is awarded upon completion of the Mask of the Revenant quest, which is unlocked after reaching Rank 2 - Observer with The Quills.

Rhino.t: Rhino's main blueprint can be purchased from the Market. Rhino's component blueprints are obtained from defeating Jackal on Fossa, Venus.

Rubico.t: The Rubico's blueprint can be purchased from the Market.

Sancti Tigris.t: The Sancti Tigris can be acquired by reaching the Rank of Flawless with New Loka, and spending 125,000 Standing 125,000 to purchase. As with all Syndicate Weapons, the Sancti Tigris cannot be chosen as the free offering upon ranking up to Flawless rank.

Saryn.t: Saryn's main blueprint can be purchased from the Market. Saryn's component blueprints are obtained from defeating Kela De Thaym on Merrow, Sedna.

Scourge.t: The Scourge's blueprint can be researched from the Tenno Lab in the dojo.

Secura Penta.t: The Secura Penta can be acquired by reaching the Rank of Partner with The Perrin Sequence, and spending 125,000 Standing 125,000 to purchase.

Sevagoth.t: Sevagoth's main blueprint is acquired after completing the Call of the Tempestarii quest.

Shedu.t: The weapon blueprint is given to the player at the end of the Erra quest. Additional blueprints can be bought from Cephalon Simaris for 100,000 Standing 100,000.

Simulor.t: The Simulor's blueprint can be purchased from Cephalon Simaris for 75,000 Standing 75,000.

Sirius & Orion.t: Sirius & Orion's main blueprint is acquired upon completion of the Jade Shadows: Constellations quest. Their component blueprints are obtained from Scoria's Angel or The Kuva Wytch on Uranus Proxima via Empyrean Railjack.

Sirocco.t: The Drifter acquires this weapon in The Duviri Paradox off the body of a Dax executor and serves as their sole firearm throughout Duviri.

Snipetron.t: The blueprint occasionally returns as an offering sold by Nakak in Cetus during the Operation: Plague Star event for 3,000 Standing 3,000 Operational Supply and 5,000 Credits.

Snipetron Vandal.t: This weapon's blueprint and parts can currently be found as Invasion rewards.

Sobek.t: The Sobek's blueprint can be purchased from the Market.

Soma.t: The Soma's blueprint can be purchased from the Market.

Sporothrix.t: The Sporothrix's blueprint and components can be acquired from Lvl 50-60 Isolation Vault Bounties (normal and Arcana).

Stahlta.t: The Stahlta's main blueprint is a possible reward from defeating the Jackal.

Steflos.t: Steflos's blueprint and components can be obtained from Mirror Defense Tyana Pass on Mars, whose access requires completion of Heart of Deimos; the blueprint comes from Rotation A, while the Barrel, Receiver, and Stock come from Rotation B.

Stradavar.t: The Stradavar's blueprint can be purchased from the Market. If unmastered, it can also be obtained via the daily login system as a random reward.

Strun.t: A built Strun can be purchased from the Market for 25,000 Credits.

Strun Wraith.t: This weapon was first introduced from the Survival Weekend Event, awarded for completing the event's Survival for 20 minutes, complete with a free weapon slot and a pre-installed Orokin Catalyst.

Styanax.t: Styanax's main and component blueprints are available from Chipper of Kahl's Garrison with Stock earned from Break Narmer weekly missions, available after completing the Veilbreaker quest.

Supra.t: The Supra's blueprint can be researched from the Energy Lab in the dojo.

Supra Vandal.t: The Supra Vandal is potentially sold by Baro Ki'Teer in the Concourse section of the Tenno Relay for 275,000 Credits and 500. Note that Baro Ki'Teer's stock changes with each appearance, and this weapon may not be available on a succeeding appearance.

Sybaris.t: The Sybaris' blueprint can be researched from the Tenno Lab in the dojo.

Synapse.t: The Synapse's blueprint can be researched from the Bio Lab in the dojo.

Synoid Simulor.t: The Synoid Simulor can be acquired by reaching the Rank of Genius with Cephalon Suda, and spending 125,000 Standing 125,000 to purchase. As with all Syndicate Weapons, the Synoid Simulor cannot be chosen as the free offering upon ranking up to Genius rank.

Telos Boltor.t: The Telos Boltor can be acquired by reaching the Rank of Maxim with the Arbiters of Hexis, and spending 125,000 Standing 125,000 to purchase. As with all Syndicate Weapons, the Telos Boltor cannot be chosen as the free offering upon ranking up to Maxim rank.

Temple.t: Temple's main and component blueprints can be obtained from the Stage Defense at Solstice Square in Höllvania. Access requires completion of The Hex Quest and Rank 4 - Hot & Fresh with The Hex Syndicate.

Tenet Arca Plasmor.t: This section is transcluded from Adversary System/Weapons § Tenet Acquisition (Sister). To change it, please edit the transcluded page. Tenet Arca Plasmor is obtained by vanquishing a Sister who generated with one equipped.

Tenet Envoy.t: This section is transcluded from Adversary System/Weapons § Tenet Acquisition (Sister). To change it, please edit the transcluded page. Tenet Envoy is obtained by vanquishing a Sister who generated with one equipped.

Tenet Ferrox.t: This section is transcluded from Adversary System/Weapons § Tenet Acquisition (Ergo Glast). To change it, please edit the transcluded page.

Tenet Flux Rifle.t: This section is transcluded from Adversary System/Weapons § Tenet Acquisition (Sister). To change it, please edit the transcluded page. Tenet Flux Rifle is obtained by vanquishing a Sister who generated with one equipped.

Tenet Glaxion.t: This section is transcluded from Adversary System/Weapons § Tenet Acquisition (Sister). To change it, please edit the transcluded page. Tenet Glaxion is obtained by vanquishing a Sister who generated with one equipped.

Tenet Quanta.t: This section is transcluded from Adversary System/Weapons § Tenet Acquisition (Sister). To change it, please edit the transcluded page. Tenet Quanta is obtained by vanquishing a Sister who generated with one equipped.

Tenet Tetra.t: This section is transcluded from Adversary System/Weapons § Tenet Acquisition (Sister). To change it, please edit the transcluded page. Tenet Tetra is obtained by vanquishing a Sister who generated with one equipped.

Tenora.t: The Tenora's blueprint can be researched from the Tenno Lab in the dojo.

Tetra.t: The Tetra's blueprint can be purchased from the Market.

Thornbak.t: Thornbak is awarded during The Teacher quest, complete with a free weapon slot and a pre-installed Orokin Catalyst. Additional copies can be purchased from Cephalon Simaris for 100,000 Standing 100,000.

Tiberon.t: The Tiberon's blueprint can be purchased from the Market.

Tigris.t: The Tigris's blueprint can be purchased from the Market.

Titania.t: Titania's main and component blueprints are obtained from The Silver Grove quest (requires The Second Dream and Mastery Rank 7).

Tonkor.t: The Tonkor's blueprint can be purchased from the Market.

Torid.t: The Torid's blueprint can be researched from the Bio Lab in the dojo.

Trinity.t: Trinity's main blueprint can be purchased from the Market. Trinity's component blueprints are obtained from defeating Ambulas on Hades, Pluto.

Trumna.t: Trumna is acquired by reaching Rank 3 - Associate with the Entrati. Father sells the main blueprint for 5,000 Standing 5,000 and component blueprints for 2,500 Standing 2,500; a total of 12,500 Standing 12,500 is needed for all parts.

Uriel.t: Uriel's main blueprint is acquired upon completion of The Old Peace quest. His component blueprints are obtained from Roathe's Oblivion on Infernium 21 of The Descendia.

Valkyr.t: Valkyr's main blueprint can be purchased from the Market. Valkyr's component blueprints can be obtained from defeating Alad V on Themisto, Jupiter.

Vauban.t: Vauban's main blueprint can be purchased from the Market. Vauban's component blueprints can be bought from the Nightwave Offerings for 25x Cred each, for a total of 75x Cred.

Vaykor Hek.t: The Vaykor Hek can be acquired by reaching the Rank of General with Steel Meridian, and spending 125,000 Standing 125,000 to purchase. As with all Syndicate Weapons, the Vaykor Hek cannot be chosen as the free offering upon ranking up to General rank.

Vectis.t: The Vectis's blueprint can be purchased from the Market.

Veldt.t: The Veldt's blueprint can be researched from the Tenno Lab in the dojo.

Vinquibus.t: Vinquibus' main and component blueprints are obtained from Roathe's Oblivion on Infernium 21 of The Descendia, available after completing The Old Peace quest.

Voidrig.t: Completion of Heart of Deimos will reward all main and component blueprints for free.

Volt.t: Volt is one of the three starter Warframes, alongside Excalibur and Mag, during Awakening. Volt's blueprints can be researched from the Tenno Lab in the dojo.

Voruna.t: Voruna's main and component blueprints can be obtained from Rotation C of Conjunction Survival Yuvarium and Circulus on Lua, whose access requires completion of The War Within.

Vulkar.t: The Vulkar's blueprint can be purchased from the Market. Alternatively, it can be acquired from completing the Mars to Ceres Junction.

Vulkar Wraith.t: The Vulkar Wraith is potentially sold by Baro Ki'Teer in the Concourse section of the Tenno Relay for 300,000 Credits and 450. Note that Baro Ki'Teer's stock changes with each appearance, and this weapon may not be available on a succeeding appearance.

Wisp.t: Wisp's main and components blueprints are acquired from defeating the Ropalolyst on The Ropalolyst, Jupiter.

Wukong.t: Wukong's blueprints can be researched from the Tenno Lab in the dojo.

Xaku.t: Xaku's main blueprint is awarded upon completion of the Heart of Deimos quest.

Yareli.t: Yareli's main blueprint is acquired by completing The Waverider quest. Component blueprints are acquired through Research inside the Ventkids' Bash Lab within the Clan Dojo.

Zarr.t: The Zarr's blueprint can be purchased from the Market.

Zenith.t: The Zenith is exclusive to the Daily Tribute system. It will become available every 200 days, beginning at day 100, until chosen as the Milestone reward. The weapon comes with its own weapon slot and a pre-installed Orokin Catalyst.

Zephyr.t: Zephyr's blueprints can be researched from the Tenno Lab in the dojo.

Zhuge.t: The Zhuge's blueprint can be purchased from the Market.
